sourceEvidence.title: Sentinel - Sr. Staff Systems Engineer
sourceEvidence.quote:
* Bachelor’s degree in STEM with 14 years of experience; 12 years of experience with a Masters’ degree in STEM; or 10 years of experience with a PhD.
* Must be a U.S Citizen with an active DoD Secret (or higher) clearance (with a background investigation within the past 6 years or enrolled into Continuous Evaluation
* Ability to obtain and maintain Special Program Access (SAP/PAR).
* 8-10 years of experience with Product Owner and Product Manager core responsibilities
* 8-10 years of experience in ICBM (MMIII or Sentinel) OR complex aerospace/defense systems
* 4 years of experience on large scale / complex system development experience across multiple phases of a development program: preliminary design, detailed design, integration and test, verification and sell off, transition to production.
* 1 year of experience with Systems Engineering program milestone events (e.g., PDR, CDR)
* 1 year of experience working with external customers to meet program expectations in a timely and efficient manner.
* 1 year of experience supporting DoD contracts and/or large supplier management portfolio experience in other industries
